rows.notes_ja: 「「阪急百貨店・阪神百貨店予約サイト」を経由し、顧客管理システムに対する第三者による不正アクセスを確認いたしました。」「現在、詳細な原因究明およびセキュリティ脆弱性の解析・調査を進めております。」親会社H2Oも同文を公表（https://data.swcms.net/file/h2o-retailing/ja/news/auto_20261019552921/pdfFile.pdf 、IR配信サービスのドメイン）。第2報 https://www.hankyu-dept.co.jp/honten/info/detail/__icsFiles/afieldfile/2026/10/30/dainihouni.pdf （原因・経路の追記なし）。H2Oの2026-09-09資料「グループ共通 ID「H2O ID」が 100 万会員を突破」は本件と無関係。公表文の単位で100万を超える行（2026年11月3日、一次公表文を再取得して照合）primary_url は第1報PDF。第2報の6,243件・188,590件・「漏えいは確認されませんでした」はこのURLにはなく、第2報のURL（上記）にある。
rows.notes_en: "We confirmed unauthorised access by a third party to the customer management system via the 'Hankyu Department Store / Hanshin Department Store reservation site'." "We are currently proceeding with detailed investigation of the cause and analysis and investigation of security vulnerabilities." The parent H2O also published the same text (https://data.swcms.net/file/h2o-retailing/ja/news/auto_20261019552921/pdfFile.pdf , domain of an IR distribution service). 2nd notice https://www.hankyu-dept.co.jp/honten/info/detail/__icsFiles/afieldfile/2026/10/30/dainihouni.pdf (no addition on cause or vector). H2O's material of 2026-09-09, "Group-wide common ID 'H2O ID' passes 1 million members", is unrelated to this matter. A row exceeding 1 million in the notice's unit (3 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked) The primary_url is the 1st-notice PDF. The 2nd notice's 6,243 records, 188,590 records and "no leak was confirmed" are not at this URL but at the 2nd notice's URL (above).

Whether it meets admission criterion 3 (leak or possibility of a leak) is for the author to decide. Follow-up notices need checking. No mention of the police or the Personal Information Protection Commission (3 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked) The notice only says "At present, no facts supporting an information leak have been confirmed" and contains no statement of the possibility or risk of a leak. On the boundary of admission criterion 3. Whether to keep it admitted or exclude it is the author's decision.

rows.notes_ja: 第一報表題「不正アクセスによるお客様情報流出の可能性および一部サービス停止のお知らせ」（投稿日2026年10月22日）。第二報 https://www.webjapan.co.jp/maintenance/serviceteishi261023/ （10/23、「2026年10月20日、第三者からの不正アクセスによりサーバー内部にマルウェアが設置されました。」、最大値として19サービスを列挙）、第三報 https://www.webjapan.co.jp/maintenance/serviceteishi261026/ （10/26、「第三者が弊社サービスの脆弱性を悪用してサーバ内へ侵入し、一部のデータを外部へ送信した事実を確認いたしました。」「弊社サービスにおけるプログラムの脆弱性を突かれたことによるものです。」）。第一報の原因「PHPの脆弱性を標的としたサイバー攻撃」は第三報で「誤報でした」と訂正。対象サービスは「MOT/HG、およびMOT/Cloud 管理システム」「MOT経費精算」「MOT勤怠管理」（いずれも一部のお客様）。利用企業の側で委託元の連鎖公表が出る可能性（2026年11月3日、一次公表文を再取得して照合）primary_url のページの本文には、1213件・875社と、第一〜第三報の状態の引用がなく、個別のURL（上記）にある。このページは、第一報の原因「PHPの脆弱性」を訂正し、「今回の事象はPHPの脆弱性を標的としたサイバー攻撃によるものではございません」「原因については我々のサービス自体の脆弱性を突かれたもの」と書く。
rows.notes_en: 1st notice title "Notice of possible outflow of customer information due to unauthorised access and suspension of some services" (posted 22 October 2026). 2nd notice https://www.webjapan.co.jp/maintenance/serviceteishi261023/ (10/23; "On 20 October 2026, malware was installed inside the server through unauthorised access by a third party."; lists 19 services as a maximum), 3rd notice https://www.webjapan.co.jp/maintenance/serviceteishi261026/ (10/26; "We confirmed the fact that a third party intruded into the server by exploiting a vulnerability in our service and sent some data to the outside." "It was caused by a vulnerability in the program of our service being exploited."). The 1st notice's cause, "a cyber attack targeting a PHP vulnerability", was corrected in the 3rd notice as "a false report". Affected services are "MOT/HG and the MOT/Cloud management system", "MOT expense settlement" and "MOT attendance management" (some customers in each). Downstream announcements by client organisations may appear on the user-company side (3 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked) The text of the primary_url page does not contain the 1,213 records and 875 companies or the status quotations of the 1st to 3rd notices; these are at the individual URLs (above). This page corrects the 1st notice's cause "PHP vulnerability", stating "This incident was not caused by a cyber attack targeting a PHP vulnerability" "the cause was a vulnerability in our service itself being exploited".

rows.notes_ja: 「当社が一部のメール配信に利用している外部システム「Cuenote FC」(運営:ユミルリンク株式会社)」「プログラムの脆弱性を利用した不正アクセスが確認され、データの出力(持ち出し)が行われた」。053（ユミルリンク）の連鎖。日付表記は原文「26.10.23」。項目・件数の記載なし （2026年11月14日訂正）2026年11月9日の第二報（https://www.istyle.co.jp/news/info/2026/11/1109-2.html 、表題「メール配信システム「Cuenote FC」への不正アクセスによる情報漏えいに関するお詫び（第二報）」）。本行の「記載なし」だった件数が示された：データベースへの不正アクセス「・対象となる人数：約280万人」（「・対象となる情報：当該配信先のメールアドレス （お取引先様を含む）」）、アドレス帳への不正アクセス「・対象となる人数：約8,000人」（「・対象となる情報：メールアドレス　※一部の方のみ、下記の項目が含まれます」「（一般のお客様）氏名」「（お取引先様）氏名、所属会社、部署名等」）。経緯「同社より11月2日に不正アクセスにより取得されたリスト、11月6日に詳細な調査結果を受領し、当社保有のメールアドレス等が漏えいしたとの報告を受けました。」。状態の語は「漏えい」（「可能性」の語なし）。経路の分類（委託先）は変わらない。攻撃側のAIへの言及なし。公表文の単位（人）で100万を超える行になる。同社の292（@cosme、約300万人）とは別事案
rows.notes_en: "the external system 'Cuenote FC' (operated by Ymirlink Inc.) that we use for part of our email delivery" "unauthorised access using a program vulnerability was confirmed, and data was output (taken out)". Downstream of row 053 (Ymirlink). The date is written "26.10.23" in the original. Items and count not stated (Corrected 14 November 2026) 2nd notice of 9 November 2026 (https://www.istyle.co.jp/news/info/2026/11/1109-2.html , title "Apology regarding the information leak due to unauthorised access to the email delivery system 'Cuenote FC' (2nd notice)"). The count, "not stated" in this row, was given: unauthorised access to the database, "- Number of persons affected: approx. 2.8 million" ("- Information affected: email addresses of the delivery destinations concerned (including business partners)"); unauthorised access to the address book, "- Number of persons affected: approx. 8,000" ("- Information affected: email address *for some persons only, the following items are included" "(general customers) name" "(business partners) name, company, department name, etc."). Background: "We received from the company, on 2 November, the list obtained through the unauthorised access and, on 6 November, the detailed investigation results, and were informed that email addresses, etc. held by us had leaked." The status word is "leak" (no word "possible"). The vector classification (contractor) does not change. No mention of AI on the attacker side. It becomes a row exceeding 1 million in the notice's unit (persons). A separate case from the company's row 292 (@cosme, approx. 3 million persons)

rows.notes_ja: 「当社が提供する「futureshop」のサーバーで使用していたソフトウェアの脆弱性を悪用された、外部からの不正アクセスが原因です。」「2026年10月17日（土）23時02分、外部の第三者が、当社サーバーで使用しているソフトウェアの脆弱性を悪用し、当社サーバーに不正にアクセスしました。」タイトルは「【重要】不正アクセスによる個人情報漏えいに関するお詫びとお知らせ（第一報）」。対象1店舗は件数が070（リンツ）と一致し、070の委託先本人の行。別に10/21の「【重要】弊社サーバーへの不正アクセスに関するお詫びとお知らせ（第一報）」https://www.future-shop.jp/news/2026/10/21.html （10/21 10:14頃に不正アクセスを確認、個人情報の記述なし）があり、10/23の事案と同一かはページから判別できない。10/25「PHP脆弱性対策に伴う長時間メンテナンス、および不正アクセス事案に関するお詫びとご説明」https://www.future-shop.jp/news/2026/10/25.html は未読。公表文の単位で100万を超える行（2026年11月21日追記）補足欄で未読とされていた「PHP脆弱性対策に伴う長時間メンテナンス、および不正アクセス事案に関するお詫びとご説明」（2026.10.25、https://www.future-shop.jp/news/2026/10/25.html ）。「今回ご説明するのは、次の3件です。いずれも別々の事象です。」として「3. 10月23日（金）公表の会員情報漏えい（1店舗）について」に「10月19日（月）に判明したもので、当社サーバーで使用していたソフトウェアの脆弱性に起因します。上記1・2のいずれとも別の事象です。」「判明後ただちに侵入経路を遮断し、脆弱性への対策を実施しております。」。10月21日の不正アクセス（「2. 10月21日（水）の不正アクセスについて」）は「futureshopの関連サービスの脆弱性を突いた不正アクセスを検知しました。」「現時点のログ調査において、本事象による個人情報の漏えいは確認されておりません。」。これで補足欄の「10/21の事案と同一かはページから判別できない」は別事象と分かった。本行の値（「3,147,469件 /1店舗」、経路「脆弱性」）は変わらない。同社お知らせ一覧（2026年11月21日取得時点）に10月23日の事案の第二報以降はない（2026-10-25、https://www.future-shop.jp/news/2026/10/25.html ）
rows.notes_en: "The cause was unauthorised access from outside exploiting a vulnerability in software used on the servers of 'futureshop', which we provide." "At 23:02 on Saturday 17 October 2026, an outside third party exploited a vulnerability in software used on our servers and gained unauthorised access to our servers." The title is "[Important] Apology and notice regarding the personal information leak due to unauthorised access (1st notice)". The count for the one affected store matches row 070 (Lindt), and this is the row for row 070's contractor itself. Separately there is 10/21's "[Important] Apology and notice regarding unauthorised access to our servers (1st notice)" https://www.future-shop.jp/news/2026/10/21.html (unauthorised access confirmed about 10:14 on 10/21; no statement on personal information); whether it is the same case as that of 10/23 cannot be determined from the page. 10/25's "Apology and explanation regarding the long maintenance for PHP vulnerability countermeasures and the unauthorised access case" https://www.future-shop.jp/news/2026/10/25.html was not read. A row exceeding 1 million in the notice's unit (Added 21 November 2026) "Apology and explanation regarding the long maintenance due to PHP vulnerability measures and the unauthorised access incidents" (2026.10.25, https://www.future-shop.jp/news/2026/10/25.html ), noted as unread in the notes. "We explain the following three matters. All are separate events." Under "3. Member information leakage (1 store) announced on Friday 23 October": "It was found on Monday 19 October and was caused by a vulnerability in software used on our server. It is a separate event from both 1 and 2 above." "Immediately after it was found we blocked the intrusion route and implemented measures against the vulnerability." On the 21 October unauthorised access ("2. Unauthorised access on Wednesday 21 October"): "We detected unauthorised access exploiting a vulnerability in a futureshop-related service." "In the log investigation so far, no leakage of personal information due to this event has been confirmed." This resolves the note that it could not be told from the page whether the 10/21 incident was the same: they are separate events. This row's values ("3,147,469 records / 1 store", vector: vulnerability) do not change. The company's notices list (as retrieved 21 November 2026) has no 2nd notice or later for the 23 October incident (2026-10-25, https://www.future-shop.jp/news/2026/10/25.html )

(7th notice). The connection information "does not include credit card information, etc." (not verified verbatim)
rows.dates_ja: メンテナンス開始（ポータル遮断）2026-10-24 3:50頃、不審な通信を確認し一部配信環境停止10-24 10:45（第2報）、全配信環境の管理者ログイン情報更新10-24 11:44頃、不正侵入の痕跡確認10-24 18:08（第5報）、八王子警察署・関連省庁へ第一報10-24、警察管理番号・IPA受付番号を公表10-28、個人情報保護委員会から委託元と連名での報告を指導10-28（日付は各報の追記時刻、逐語未確認）
rows.dates_en: Maintenance began (portal blocked) about 3:50 on 2026-10-24; suspicious communications confirmed and some delivery environments stopped 10:45 on 10-24 (2nd notice); administrator login information for all delivery environments updated about 11:44 on 10-24; traces of unauthorised intrusion confirmed 18:08 on 10-24 (5th notice); first report to Hachioji Police Station and relevant ministries 10-24; police reference number and IPA receipt number published 10-28; the Personal Information Protection Commission instructed a joint report with clients 10-28 (dates are the times of each notice's additions; not verified verbatim)
rows.notes_ja: 「現在、外部の第三者からの攻撃的アクセスならびに不正侵入の痕跡が確認されたため、ポータルサイトをメンテナンス状態にさせていただいております。」「攻撃によって漏洩した可能性がある認証情報により、一部のお客様の配信環境のWEBアプリに侵入され、そこで管理しているお客様管理の宛先に、フィッシングメールが送信された恐れがあります。」第7報は侵入のきっかけを「お客様環境のセットアップ用スクリプト」とする（逐語未確認）。ポータルへの侵入と、そこで得た認証情報による配信環境への侵入の二段階として「複合」に分類（著者判断）。1ページに第2報〜第18報（2026-11-01 15:32）を追記する形式で、「第1報」と明示された告知はページ内にない。第17報（10-31）で既存顧客の配信環境は11月4日ころから順次再開見込み（逐語未確認）。個人情報の該当性はメールアドレス閲覧の可能性のみで、持ち出しは未確認。収載は著者判断。委託元（報道では双葉町、南魚沼市ほか）の公表文は未確認で、委託元ごとに別行の候補（2026年11月3日、一次公表文を再取得して照合）第19報（2026-11-03）が同じページにあり、総件数22,527件を報告する。第6報の「最大30件」は経過として残した。
rows.notes_en: "Because traces of aggressive access and unauthorised intrusion by an outside third party have now been confirmed, we have put the portal site into maintenance." "Using authentication information that may have leaked in the attack, the web applications of some customers' delivery environments were intruded into, and phishing emails may have been sent to recipients managed by customers there." The 7th notice gives the trigger for the intrusion as "setup scripts for customer environments" (not verified verbatim). Classified as "multiple vectors" as a two-stage intrusion: into the portal, then into delivery environments using authentication information obtained there (author's decision). A single page with the 2nd to 18th notices (2026-11-01 15:32) added in turn; there is no notice explicitly labelled "1st notice" on the page. The 17th notice (10-31) says existing customers' delivery environments are expected to resume in turn from around 4 November (not verified verbatim). The only personal-information relevance is the possibility that email addresses were viewed; removal has not been confirmed. Admission is the author's decision. Notices by client organisations (according to press reports, Futaba Town, Minamiuonuma City and others) have not been checked; each is a candidate for a separate row (3 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked) The 19th notice (2026-11-03) is on the same page and reports a total of 22,527 records. The 6th notice's "up to 30 records" was kept as part of the progression.

rows.notes_en: Title "Apology and notice regarding some pages of the overseas hotel booking site and the multilingual booking site". Vector: "we confirmed that there was unauthorised access by an outside third party"; the specific cause is not stated. Incident (1) was detected and fixed in September and was not announced until 26 October. Press reports give totals such as "up to approx. 3.5 million records", but the notice gives figures by category and does not add them up (do not add them). rows.notes_en: Title "On the risk of an information leak due to unauthorised access to a contractor". "It was found that the own servers of LevelEnter Inc., to which we outsource the marking of recruitment-exam essays, had been subjected to unauthorised access". No posting date is given, only "updated 27 October 2026"; published is the update date (the first publication date is for the author to check). The cause is not stated. The only personal information is one employee's name; there is room for the author to decide whether to admit it. A separate case from row 060 (Tokyo Metropolitan Government, blastmail) (3 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked) The notice says "One of the 198 records contains the name of a department employee, and the others contain no personal information". The 198 records are the number of answer images and marking results. On the admission boundary (the only personal information is one employee's name).

の行の委託先。お知らせ一覧の他記事に「メール×AI×営業」（自社セミナー名）があるが本文外。第2報（2026年11月2日、https://www.arara.com/dcms_media/other/arara_20261102__.pdf ）は著者未読。別の調査の記録では「約77百万件」、侵入された利用企業「最大約380社」（逐語未確認）。初報の「約301万件」は2026-11-03に再取得して逐語を確認（「本環境を利用するご利用企業様が保有するメールアドレス約301万件が外部に持ち出されたことを確認しております。」、経路「Webサーバーの脆弱性を第三者に悪用されたものです。」）（2026年11月8日訂正）2026年11月6日の第3報（https://www.arara.com/news/info/20261106_arara ）：「持ち出されたメールアドレスは、重複を除いて81,329,467件（約8,100万件）です」（本サービスを経由した不正アクセス78,102,937件、共用環境2,842,400件、別のクラウド環境3,249,492件の区分間の重複を除いた件数。共用環境の件数は第2報の3,386,187件から改めた）。「対象となるご契約企業は、最大約380社と推計しております（精査中）」。「10月28日から30日にかけて、送信元「news@arara.com」から、クレジットカード会社を装った不審メールが最大約713万通送信されました。」10月31日に全サービスを停止。侵入経路は「特定を進めております」。（2026年11月21日追記）アララメッセージ臨時サイト（https://am.arara.com/info/news/ ）（2026年11月21日追記）アララメッセージ臨時サイト（https://am.arara.com/info/news/ 、「最終更新：2026年11月19日 rows.notes_en: "In some environments of our system, a vulnerability in a web server was exploited by a third party." "We have confirmed unauthorised access to one system among the server systems of the email delivery service we provide, and that approx. 3.01 million email addresses held by user companies using this environment were taken outside." The candidate announcement date was 10/28, but the pages of 10/28 (https://am.arara.com/news/2026102801 , /2026102802) say only "The service has been stopped due to the effects of unauthorised access", with no statement of a leak. The leak first appears in the notice dated 10/29, so published=2026-10-29. The 2nd notice in press reports (11/2, approx. 77 million records) was not in the arara.com notice list (at the time of retrieval). In res_1029_1102.json it is excluded as "outside the range (10/28)", but since the leak was announced on 10/29 it is appropriate to treat it as a row within that range (beware of duplication). The contractor for the rows of the four Paydon banks, the Japan Society of Civil Engineers, Okinawa Prefecture, Suzuki and AUTHENTIC JAPAN. Another article in the notice list mentions "Email × AI × Sales" (the company's own seminar name), outside the text. The 2nd notice (2 November 2026, https://www.arara.com/dcms_media/other/arara_20261102__.pdf ) was not read by the author. Another investigation's record gives "approx. 77 million records" and user companies intruded into "up to approx. 380 companies" (not verified verbatim). The first notice's "approx. 3.01 million records" was re-retrieved on 2026-11-03 and the wording verified ("We have confirmed that approx. 3.01 million email addresses held by user companies using this environment were taken outside."; vector "a vulnerability in a web server was exploited by a third party.") (Corrected 8 November 2026) 3rd notice of 6 November 2026 (https://www.arara.com/news/info/20261106_arara ): "The email addresses taken out number 81,329,467 (approx. 81 million), excluding duplicates" (the count after removing duplicates between the categories of unauthorised access via this service, 78,102,937; the shared environment, 2,842,400; and another cloud environment, 3,249,492; the shared-environment count was revised from the 2nd notice's 3,386,187). "We estimate the affected client companies at up to approx. 380 companies (under examination)". "From 28 to 30 October, up to approx. 7.13 million suspicious emails impersonating credit card companies were sent from the sender 'news@arara.com'." All services were stopped on 31 October. On the intrusion path: "we are proceeding with identification". (Added 21 November 2026) The Arara Message temporary site (https://am.arara.com/info/news/ ) carries "Correction of, and apology for, the content of individual notifications concerning unauthorised access to 'Arara Message' (6 November 2026)". "On 2 November we individually notified some business partners subject to '2.(1) Unauthorised access via this service' in the 2nd notice of the details of this incident." "At that time we conveyed incorrect information about the period during which data was taken out, so we correct it as follows." Wrong: "Data was taken out of each server at some point between 28 and 29 October." -> Correct: "From 28 October until the service was stopped on 31 October, data was continuously taken out of each server (the date and time of exfiltration differs by server)." "In addition, with the correction of the exfiltration period, the scope of data subject to the outflow (scope of impact) conveyed individually to some business partners was also wrong." The correction concerns individual notifications to client companies; this row's values ("approx. 3.01 million email addresses", vector: vulnerability) do not change. The item has no separate URL; it is posted in the notices section of the temporary site (2026-11-06, https://am.arara.com/info/news/ ) (Added 21 November 2026) Arara Message temporary site (https://am.arara.com/info/news/ , "Last updated: 19 November 2026 23:00"). "The application deadline for joint reports and proxy reports to the Personal Information Protection Commission closed at 23:00 on Thursday 19 November 2026." On the timing of service resumption: "It remains undecided at present." "We are individually informing customers of the impact on each customer (whether information flowed out, the number of records, details) in turn, starting with customers whose investigation results have been finalised." "We are continuing to investigate the scope of impact." No update to counts or vector (procedural update). On the arara.com notices list (https://www.arara.com/news/info/ ), the 6 November article is the latest; there is no 4th notice or later (as retrieved 21 November 2026) (2026-11-19, https://am.arara.com/info/news/ )

"*Credit card numbers, including the last 4 digits we hold, are not subject to this leak." rows.notes_ja: 「外部からの不正なアクセスを検知し、該当箇所へのアクセスの遮断および修正の適用を行いました」。ニュースページの掲載日表示は2026年11月2日（本文日付は10月30日）。PR TIMES同文 https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000001877.000000987.html は開けず。公表文の単位で100万を超える行（2026年11月8日追記）2026年11月4日の第二報（https://www.ryohin-keikaku.jp/news/articles/2026_1104_02 ）：「①の約2,726万件の中に、無印良品ネットストア会員（MUJI アプリを利用されていない方を含む）が含まれること」「一部の方は、氏名、住所、電話番号が含まれていることがわかりました。」「クレジットカード情報につきましても、外部からアクセスされた可能性があることが判明しました。」件数の内訳は画像の表で未読。（2026年11月10日追記）2026年11月9日の第四報（https://www.ryohin-keikaku.jp/news/articles/2026_1109_01 、PDF：https://files.microcms-assets.io/assets/1abbce69114443b0af3672230990db72/e51754a43b58416ba83ad4b641b3121b/261109_%E7%AC%AC4%E5%A0%B1%EF%BC%BF%E6%83%85%E5%A0%B1%E6%BC%8F%E6%B4%A9%E3%83%AA%E3%83%AA%E3%83%BC%E3%82%B9_.pdf ）：表題「無印良品の公式アプリ「MUJI アプリ」におけるお客さま情報流出の可能性について（第四報）」。ネットストアについて「第三者が外部で不正に入手した可能性のあるパスワード等の情報を使用した、多数のログイン試行、いわゆる「リスト型攻撃」が行われており」「不正なログインが行われた可能性があることが判明いたしました」。新たな対象として「2020年1月2日から2025年2月10日までの間に代金引換配送の受取先となったお客さまの情報の一部につきましても、不正アクセスがなされたことを確認しております」。「当社は、更なる総合的なセキュリティ強化が必要と判断し、ネットストアの再開を延期することといたしました。」（11月6日（金）16時から一時停止中。11/6付の第三報 https://www.ryohin-keikaku.jp/news/articles/2026_1106_01 では「1～2日以内を目途」の再開予定だった）。「これまでにお知らせしている件数にも一部変更がございます」とあるが、件数の表（「下記１」）は HTML・PDF とも 取得できず（画像の可能性）、変更後の件数は未確認。リスト型攻撃の確認日・件数の記載は本文になし。
rows.notes_en: "We detected unauthorised access from outside, blocked access to the affected area and applied a fix." The posting date shown on the news page is 2 November 2026 (the text is dated 30 October). The same text on PR TIMES, https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000001877.000000987.html , could not be opened. A row exceeding 1 million in the notice's unit (Added 8 November 2026) 2nd notice of 4 November 2026 (https://www.ryohin-keikaku.jp/news/articles/2026_1104_02 ): "that the approx. 27.26 million records in (1) include MUJI net store members (including those who do not use the MUJI app)" "It was found that for some persons, names, addresses and phone numbers are included." "It was found that credit card information may also have been accessed from outside." The breakdown of the counts is in an image of a table and was not read. (Added 10 November 2026) 4th notice of 9 November 2026 (https://www.ryohin-keikaku.jp/news/articles/2026_1109_01 , PDF: https://files.microcms-assets.io/assets/1abbce69114443b0af3672230990db72/e51754a43b58416ba83ad4b641b3121b/261109_%E7%AC%AC4%E5%A0%B1%EF%BC%BF%E6%83%85%E5%A0%B1%E6%BC%8F%E6%B4%A9%E3%83%AA%E3%83%AA%E3%83%BC%E3%82%B9_.pdf ): title "On the possibility of an outflow of customer information in MUJI's official app 'MUJI app' (4th notice)". On the net store: "numerous login attempts, a so-called 'list-based attack', were carried out using information such as passwords that a third party may have obtained without authorisation elsewhere" "it was found that unauthorised logins may have been made". Newly affected: "We have also confirmed that unauthorised access was made to part of the information of customers who were recipients of cash-on-delivery shipments between 2 January 2020 and 10 February 2025". "We judged that further comprehensive strengthening of security is necessary and decided to postpone the reopening of the net store." (temporarily suspended from 16:00 on Friday 6 November; the 3rd notice of 11/6, https://www.ryohin-keikaku.jp/news/articles/2026_1106_01 , had planned reopening "within 1 to 2 days"). It says "there are also some changes to the counts announced so far", but the table of counts ("1 below") could not be retrieved in either HTML or PDF (possibly an image), and the revised counts have not been confirmed. The text gives no date of confirmation or count for the list-based attack.

rows.notes_en: "unauthorised access from outside to part of our servers". It says the intrusion path has been identified and fixed, but its content is not stated. The title says "(1st message)". The parent KNT-CT Holdings also posted an apology for the same case on 2026-11-01, https://www.kntcthd.co.jp/ja/release/2026/20261101.html (included in the same row). A row exceeding 1 million in the notice's unit (Added 21 November 2026) 2nd communication (https://www.club-t.com/ct/news/2026/1107_1/ , title "Apology and notice regarding personal information leakage due to unauthorised access (2nd communication: on the resumption of the website)", 7 November 2026). "On 30 October 2026 we confirmed unauthorised access from outside to part of our servers, and on the 31st of that month announced that part of customers' information may have leaked outside." "As the measures and checks necessary for resumption have been completed, our website has today resumed, except for some pages." "The 'Travel memories photo contest page' remains suspended." No count or intrusion route stated (procedural update). The notice is on the club-t.com domain (this row's primary_url is on club-tourism.co.jp). The company's notices section separately has, dated 17 November 2026, "Apology and notice regarding the possibility of personal information leakage due to unauthorised access at PLAID, Inc." (https://www.club-t.com/ct/news/2026/1117_1/ , body not read), a separate incident from this row (possibly the KARTE chain; not made into a row as it is outside this assignment) (2026-11-07, https://www.club-t.com/ct/news/2026/1107_1/ )

rows.notes_en: Timely disclosure (the TDnet original https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120261102563007.pdf could not be retrieved; the same text distributed by Yahoo! Finance). The notice says "we took measures such as invalidating the authentication information used without authorisation", but it only says the intrusion path and cause are under investigation and does not say "unauthorised login", so it is classified as vector not disclosed (changed from unauthorised login on 2026-11-03). That names are among the data affected is not verified verbatim. A row exceeding 1 million in the notice's unit (Added 8 November 2026) 2nd notice of 6 November 2026 (https://www.prestigein.com/Portals/0/pdf/NEWS/news_20261106_01.pdf ): newly confirmed a leak of "credit card information (card numbers)", "3 records". No update to the number of persons affected. Announcements on the client side (Nissan Financial Services, JA Kyosairen, KDDI, Porsche Japan) were added as rows in the fifth edition.

rows.org_ja: Zaif（暗号資産取引所・業務委託先アララ）
rows.org_en: Zaif Inc. (crypto exchange, via contractor Arara)
rows.scale_ja: 記載なし
rows.status_ja: 「情報流出の可能性」（タイトル）。利用者のメールアドレスが対象に含まれるかは「調査中であり、特定に至っておりません」
rows.status_en: Possible exfiltration; whether users' addresses are included is under investigation
rows.data_ja: 「当社が同社のサービスに登録している情報はメールアドレスのみです。」「氏名、住所、電話番号、取引情報、パスワード等は登録しておらず、これらが流出することはありません。」
rows.data_en: "The only information we register with the company's service is email addresses." "Names, addresses, phone numbers, transaction information, passwords, etc. are not registered, so they cannot flow out."
rows.dates_ja: アララ社から連絡受領2026-11-02
rows.dates_en: Contact received from Arara 2026-11-02
rows.notes_ja: 「アララ株式会社において、第三者による不正アクセスが発生し、当社が利用する環境を含むサーバーから情報が外部に流出したことが確認された旨の報告を同社より受けました。」「当社システムへの不正アクセスは確認されておりません。」自社環境からの流出は確認されたが、利用者のメールアドレスが含まれるかは未特定のため、基準3（漏えいの可能性）を満たすかは著者の判断。社名はフッターの「© Ｚａｉｆ　Ｉｎｃ．」のみ取得（日本語の商号は未確認）。アララ連鎖（2026年11月3日、一次公表文を再取得して照合）「当社が同社のサービスに登録しているお客さまのメールアドレスが対象に含まれているか否かにつきましては、現在同社において調査中であり、特定に至っておりません」。自組織分の漏えいは未判明。収載基準3の境界。収載を続けるか除外するかは著者判断。
rows.notes_en: "We received a report from Arara Inc. that unauthorised access by a third party occurred at the company and that it was confirmed that information flowed out to the outside from servers including the environment we use." "No unauthorised access to our systems has been confirmed." An outflow from its environment was confirmed, but whether users' email addresses are included has not been determined, so whether it meets criterion 3 (possibility of a leak) is the author's decision. The company name was obtained only from the footer, "© Ｚａｉｆ　Ｉｎｃ．" (the Japanese trade name not confirmed). Downstream of Arara (3 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked) "Whether the email addresses of our customers registered with the company's service are included is currently being investigated by the company and has not been determined". A leak of the organisation's own data is not established. On the boundary of admission criterion 3. Whether to keep it admitted or exclude it is the author's decision.

rows.vector: 不正アクセス（経路未公表）
rows.dates_ja: 漏えい確認2026-10-28（水）、個人情報保護委員会へ報告済み（日付記載なし）、対象者への個別連絡の完了予定2026-11-06（金）
rows.dates_en: Leak confirmed Wednesday 2026-10-28; reported to the Personal Information Protection Commission (date not stated); individual contact with those affected scheduled for completion Friday 2026-11-06
rows.notes_ja: 「2026年10月28日（水）、@cosmeへの第三者による不正アクセスにより、@cosme共通IDに登録されているお客様の会員情報の一部が外部に漏えいしたことを確認いたしました。」経路の記載なし（「第三者のセキュリティ専門会社と原因および影響範囲の調査を進めております」）。退会済み会員も不正アクセス時点で会員なら対象（要約で取得、逐語未確認）。同社は2026-10-23に別件「メール配信システム「Cuenote FC」への不正アクセスについて」（https://www.istyle.co.jp/news/info/2026/10/20261023.html 、053ユミルリンクの連鎖、担当範囲外）を公表しており、本件とは別の公表文。11/2時点で同社お知らせ一覧には未掲載だったが、URLを直接開いて取得
rows.notes_en: "On Wednesday 28 October 2026, we confirmed that, due to unauthorised access by a third party to @cosme, part of the member information of customers registered with the @cosme common ID leaked to the outside." Vector not stated ("we are proceeding with investigating the cause and scope of impact with a third-party security company"). Cancelled members are also affected if they were members at the time of the unauthorised access (obtained as a summary; not verified verbatim). On 2026-10-23 the company announced a separate matter, "On unauthorised access to the email delivery system 'Cuenote FC'" (https://www.istyle.co.jp/news/info/2026/10/20261023.html ; downstream of row 053 Ymirlink; outside this worker's range), a different notice from this one. As of 11/2 it was not in the company's notice list, but it was retrieved by opening the URL directly

rows.org_ja: ライフコーポレーション（ライフ公式アプリ）
rows.org_en: Life Corporation (Life official app)
rows.status_ja: 「閲覧された可能性があることが判明いたしました」「漏えいした可能性があることを確認いたしました」
rows.data_ja: 「お客様の氏名、生年月日、住所、郵便番号、電話番号、電子マネー残高、ポイントカード番号、ポイント残高」。「「LC JCB カード」のクレジットカード番号については、漏えいしておりません。」「ライフアプリではクレジットカード情報は保持しておりません。」
rows.data_en: "Customers' name, date of birth, address, postal code, phone number, electronic money balance, point card number, point balance". "Credit card numbers of the 'LC JCB Card' have not leaked." "The Life app does not hold credit card information."
rows.dates_ja: 不正アクセス確認2026-10-30（金）、公表2026-11-02。個人情報保護委員会へ報告（日付記載なし）
rows.dates_en: Unauthorised access confirmed Friday 2026-10-30; announced 2026-11-02. Reported to the Personal Information Protection Commission (date not stated)
rows.notes_ja: 「ライフアプリに対し、大量かつ自動的な認証の試行と考えられる不正アクセスが行われ、個人情報が閲覧された可能性があることを確認しております。」自動的な認証の試行（リスト型・総当たり型とみられる）のため不正ログインに分類。「対象人数や対象となる情報の詳細は現在調査中であり、今後の調査の進展により、対象件数や対象となる情報が変更になる可能性があります。」報道では「298件」（流通ニュース）と「289件」（商業界系）が揺れるが、公表文は「298 件」
rows.notes_en: "We have confirmed that unauthorised access, thought to be large-scale automated authentication attempts, was carried out against the Life app and that personal information may have been viewed." Classified as unauthorised login because of automated authentication attempts (apparently list-based or brute-force). "The number of persons affected and details of the information affected are currently under investigation, and the number of records and information affected may change as the investigation progresses." Press reports vary between "298 records" (Ryutsu News) and "289 records" (Shogyokai-affiliated), but the notice says "298 records"

rows.org_ja: 丸井グループ（デジタル社債の管理業務・委託先セキュリタイズ）
rows.org_en: Marui Group (digital bond administration, via contractor Securitize Japan)
rows.scale_ja: 「最大9086名」（「うち銀行口座番号まで漏えいした可能性のあるお客さまは54名」）
rows.scale_en: "Max. 9,086 persons" (of whom 54 possibly including bank account numbers)
rows.status_ja: 「一部漏えいしたことが確認されました」
rows.data_ja: 「お客さまの氏名、住所、電話番号、メールアドレス、生年月日、性別、銀行口座番号および投資口数」。「セキュリタイズ社にはクレジットカードに関する情報は委託をしていないため、今回漏えいはございません」
rows.data_en: "Customers' name, address, phone number, email address, date of birth, sex, bank account number and number of investment units". "Because we do not entrust credit card information to Securitize, there has been no leak of it this time"
rows.dates_ja: 委託先サーバーへの不正アクセス2026-10-29（木）。個人情報保護委員会・警察への報告の記載なし
rows.dates_en: Unauthorised access to the contractor's servers Thursday 2026-10-29. No statement of reports to the Personal Information Protection Commission or the police
rows.notes_ja: 「丸井グループの発行するデジタル社債の管理業務に関する委託先企業であるセキュリタイズ社のサーバーが第三者による不正アクセスを受け」。委託先はSecuritize Japan株式会社（1回目の取得では「Securitize Japan株式会社（セキュリタイズ社）」と要約で返った。正式表記は逐語未確認）。件数表記は2回の取得で「9,086」（要約）と「9086」（抜き出し）に揺れたため、カンマの有無は逐語未確認。スターツ証券（10/31、委託先Securitize）と同じ委託先。NTTデータのSTdirectServices連鎖（近鉄GHD・カゴメ・楽天証券ほか）の委託先SaaSもSecuritizeと報道（日経クロステック）されており、同一事案の可能性があるが、丸井の公表文はNTTデータに触れていない。丸井自身のシステムからの漏えいは「現時点で確認されていない」旨（要約で取得、逐語未確認）
rows.notes_en: "the servers of Securitize, the contractor for administration of digital bonds issued by Marui Group, were subjected to unauthorised access by a third party". The contractor is Securitize Japan K.K. (the first retrieval returned "Securitize Japan K.K. (Securitize)" as a summary; the official notation not verified verbatim). The count appeared as "9,086" (summary) and "9086" (extraction) in two retrievals, so whether it has a comma is not verified verbatim. The same contractor as Starts Securities (10/31, contractor Securitize). Press reports (Nikkei xTECH) say the contractor SaaS in NTT DATA's STdirectServices chain (Kintetsu GHD, Kagome, Rakuten Securities and others) is also Securitize, so it may be the same incident, but Marui's notice does not mention NTT DATA. The gist that no leak from Marui's own systems "has been confirmed at present" (obtained as a summary; not verified verbatim)

rows.scale_ja: 「約 55 万件」（会員のメールアドレス）

rows.dates_ja: 委託先が利用するメール配信サービスへの不正アクセス2026-10-28〜10-31、判明・公表2026-11-02。個人情報保護委員会・警察への報告の記載なし
rows.dates_en: Unauthorised access to the email delivery service used by the contractor 2026-10-28 to 10-31; found and announced 2026-11-02. No statement of reports to the Personal Information Protection Commission or the police
rows.notes_ja: 「当社会員サービス「ほくリンク」の会員向けのメール配信を委託している外部の運営会社が利用する、メール配信サービスへの不正アクセスが発生したことに伴い」「これにより個人情報（最大約 380 社分、約 7,700 万件）が外部へ流出し」。公表文に配信サービス名・事業者名の記載はないが、「最大約380社」「約7,700万件」はアララの第2報（2026-11-02）と一致し、報道もアララ経由とする。アララ（10/28〜29初報、担当範囲外・台帳未収載）の連鎖。数字の間に空白が入るPDF表記をそのまま写した
rows.notes_en: "following the occurrence of unauthorised access to the email delivery service used by the external operating company to which we outsource email delivery to members of our member service 'Hokulink'" "as a result, personal information (up to approx. 380 companies, approx. 77 million records) flowed out to the outside". The notice does not name the delivery service or company, but "up to approx. 380 companies" and "approx. 77 million records" match Arara's 2nd notice (2026-11-02), and press reports also say it was via Arara. Downstream of Arara (first notice 10/28–29; outside this worker's range; not in the registry). The PDF's notation with spaces between the numbers was copied as is

rows.notes_en: "it was found that, after [Arara] was subjected to unauthorised access by a third party, FitDish customers' email address information flowed out." (an extraction omitting the preceding and following sentences), "On 2 November 2026, we received a report from Arara that FitDish customers' email address information had flowed out." Downstream of Arara (outside this worker's range; not in the registry). Press reports vary between "approx. 34,000 records" and "approx. 35,000 records", but the notice says "34,489 records"

rows.scale_ja: 記載なし
rows.status_ja: 「個人情報が漏えいした可能性がある」
rows.data_ja: 「メールアドレス、氏名等の情報」。「クレジットカードの情報は含んでおりません。」
rows.data_en: "Information such as email addresses and names". "Credit card information is not included."
rows.dates_ja: TKCから不正アクセス発生の報告2026-10-28、TKCから「情報漏えいはない」と報告2026-10-30、外部サービス緊急停止の報告2026-10-31 17:37、アララ社が情報漏えいを公表2026-11-02、資料提供日2026-11-02。個人情報保護委員会・警察への報告の記載なし
rows.dates_en: Report from TKC of the occurrence of unauthorised access 2026-10-28; TKC reported "there is no information leak" 2026-10-30; report of emergency stop of the external service 17:37 on 2026-10-31; Arara announced the information leak 2026-11-02; material provided 2026-11-02. No statement of reports to the Personal Information Protection Commission or the police
rows.notes_ja: 「同社が利用する外部サービスにおいて、サーバーへの不正アクセスが発生したとの通知がありました。」「当該外部サービス再委託先であるアララ社」。委託先は株式会社TKC、再委託先はアララ株式会社「アララメッセージ」。10/30にいったん「情報漏えいはない」と報告を受けた経緯が経緯表にある。ナビゲーションの「AIチャットボット」は市サイトのメニューで本件と無関係。アララ連鎖（2026年11月8日追記）初報ページの関連リンクに「【第2報】」があるが、URLは未特定で本文未読。
rows.notes_en: "We were notified that unauthorised access to a server had occurred in an external service used by the company." "Arara, the subcontractor for the external service concerned". The contractor is TKC Corporation; the subcontractor is Arara Inc. ("Arara Message"). The timeline table records that on 10/30 they were once told "there is no information leak". "AI chatbot" in the navigation is a menu item of the city site and unrelated to this matter. Downstream of Arara (Added 8 November 2026) The related links on the first-notice page include a "[2nd notice]", but its URL has not been identified and its text not read.

rows.org_ja: 神戸新聞社（メールマガジン・委託先アララ）
rows.org_en: Kobe Shimbun (newsletter, via Arara)

rows.status_ja: 「漏えいしたとの連絡を１１月２日に受けました」
rows.data_ja: 「当社のメールマガジン受信者の個人情報（メールアドレスのみ）」
rows.data_en: "Personal information of our newsletter recipients (email addresses only)"
rows.dates_en: Contact received from Arara 2026-11-02; posted 18:20 on 2026-11-02
rows.notes_ja: 「当社がメールサービスの配信に利用している「アララメッセージ」について、提供するアララ株式会社から不正アクセスによる情報流出が発生し、当社のメールマガジン受信者の個人情報（メールアドレスのみ）、約４万件が漏えいしたとの連絡を１１月２日に受けました。」1回目の取得は要約、2回目の抜き出しで上記の文を取得（全角数字はWebFetchの返答のまま、逐語未確認）。アララ連鎖。報道機関自身の「インフォメーション」欄の公表

Announced in the news organisation's own "Information" section

rows.dates_en: Arara's announcement 2026-11-02 ("11/2 (Mon)" in the notice's timeline). "We are proceeding with the reporting procedure to the Personal Information Protection Commission together with the contractor and Arara"
rows.notes_ja: 「当社が運営する会員プログラム「都プラス」向けメール配信業務を委託している事業者（以下、委託先）が利用しているアララ株式会社（以下、アララ社）のメール配信サービスにおいて、第三者による不正アクセスが発生し」。委託先（中間事業者）の社名は記載なし。運営会社名はフッターの英文表記「Kintetsu Miyako Hotels International, Inc.」のみ取得（日本語の社名表記はページ内で未確認）。アララ連鎖
rows.notes_en: "unauthorised access by a third party occurred in the email delivery service of Arara Inc. Vector: "How the unauthorised access became possible and the detailed cause are currently being investigated in cooperation with an external specialist body." "We do not hold credit card numbers, and they have not leaked." States that no leak of login passwords has been confirmed. The announcement date is outside the period 11/3–11/8 (author's decision).

rows.notes_ja: 照合待ちから再照合。表題「外部サービスへの不正アクセスによる投資家様情報漏えいの可能性について」（HTML https://www.westjr.co.jp/press/article/2026/10/31/page_31177.html ）。株式会社NTTデータから、その委託先の「デジタル証券プラットフォーム」への第三者の不正アクセスの報告。侵入経路・技術的原因は未特定。販売会社の楽天証券が対象投資家へ個別連絡。NTTデータの第2報（2026-11-02）https://www.nttdata.com/global/ja/news/release/2026/110200 は委託先Securitize Japanの「システムの認証機能の脆弱性を悪用して管理者権限が不正に取得され」と記載（発行体名は記載なし）。連鎖名：NTTデータ／Securitize Japan。期間外（著者判断）。
rows.notes_en: Re-checked from pending. Title "On the possibility of a leak of investor information due to unauthorised access to an external service" (HTML https://www.westjr.co.jp/press/article/2026/10/31/page_31177.html ). Report from NTT DATA Corporation of unauthorised access by a third party to its contractor's "digital securities platform". Intrusion path and technical cause not identified. The selling company, Rakuten Securities, contacted affected investors individually. NTT DATA's 2nd notice (2026-11-02), https://www.nttdata.com/global/ja/news/release/2026/110200 , states for the contractor Securitize Japan that "administrator privileges were obtained without authorisation by exploiting a vulnerability in the system's authentication function" (issuers not named). Chain: NTT DATA / Securitize Japan. Outside the collection period (author's decision).

rows.notes_ja: 表題「メール配信委託先への不正アクセスによる情報漏えいの可能性について（第1報）」（2026年11月2日）。経路逐語「第三者による不正アクセスを受け」「本件はアララ株式会社のサービスに対する不正アクセス」。第3報 https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261104/ （「メール配信委託先への不正アクセスによる情報漏えいに関する件（第3報）」）、11/6 https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261106/ （「当社のメール配信委託先における不正アクセスと一部報道について」「当社のシステムおよびデータセンターが不正アクセスを受けた事実は、現時点で確認されておりません。」）。第4版で漏れていた連鎖の中間事業者。担当期間の自治体約60行の親事案。連鎖名：アララ（241）／TKC（2026年11月10日、一次公表文を再取得して照合し、一次URLは第1報（2026年11月2日）で、規模の欄の第3報の値（「最大223万812件」）はこのURLにはない。第3報は補足欄の https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261104/ ）（2026年11月21日追記）補足欄に未反映の第4報〜第6報。第4報（2026年11月4日、https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261104_1 、表題「アララ株式会社の「アララメッセージ」への不正アクセスによる情報漏えいの可能性に関するご報告（第4報）」）：「本日（11月4日）、アララ株式会社より、漏えいしたメールアドレスの情報提供を受けました。」「現在、当社はアララ株式会社と協力して、どのお客さまの、どのシステムに関するメールアドレスが漏えいしたかについて分類する作業に着手しました。」。第5報（2026年11月6日、https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261106_1 ）：「どのお客さまの、どのシステムに関するメールアドレスが漏えいしたかについては、引き続きアララ株式会社の協力を得ながら分類する作業を行っています。」と各システムの再開日の表。第6報（2026年11月9日、https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261109_1 ）：「メールアドレスが漏えいしたシステムは以下に絞られることが判明しました。」として、会計事務所向け（「事務所通信デジタル版」、FXシリーズ「連絡先登録機能」の登録完了メール）と地方公共団体向け（「スマート申請システム」「マイナンバーカード交付予約・管理システム」「申請管理システム」「緊急連絡先登録システム」）を挙げる（システム名の列挙は WebFetch の抜粋で、表記の逐語は未確認）。「なお、本件はアララメッセージに対する不正アクセスであり、TKCのシステムおよびデータセンターへの不正アクセスは、現時点で確認されておりません。」。第4報〜第6報に件数の記載はなく（第6報に「件」を含む本文の文なし）、第3報の「最大223万812件」の更新なし（2026-11-09、https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261109_1 ）
rows.notes_en: Title "On the possibility of an information leak due to unauthorised access to the email delivery contractor (1st notice)" (2 November 2026). Wording of the vector: "was subjected to unauthorised access by a third party" "This matter is unauthorised access to the service of Arara Inc." 3rd notice https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261104/ ("Matter relating to the information leak due to unauthorised access to the email delivery contractor (3rd notice)"); 11/6 https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261106/ ("On unauthorised access at our email delivery contractor and some press reports"; "At present, no fact that our systems or data centres were subjected to unauthorised access has been confirmed."). The intermediary in a chain missed in the fourth edition. The parent case of about 60 local-government rows in this check's period. Chain: Arara (241) / TKC (10 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked: the primary URL is the 1st notice (2 November 2026), and the 3rd notice's value in the scale field ("up to 2,230,812 records") is not at this URL. The 3rd notice is https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261104/ in the notes) (Added 21 November 2026) 4th to 6th notices not yet reflected in the notes. 4th notice (4 November 2026, https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261104_1 , title "Report on the possibility of information leakage due to unauthorised access to Arara Inc.'s 'Arara Message' (4th notice)"): "Today (4 November) we received information on the leaked email addresses from Arara Inc." "We have now begun, in cooperation with Arara Inc., the work of classifying which customers' email addresses for which systems were leaked." 5th notice (6 November 2026, https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261106_1 ): "We are continuing, with the cooperation of Arara Inc., the work of classifying which customers' email addresses for which systems were leaked." plus a table of resumption dates. 6th notice (9 November 2026, https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261109_1 ): "It has become clear that the systems from which email addresses were leaked are narrowed down to the following." listing, for accounting firms, the 'Office Newsletter Digital Edition' and the registration-completion emails of the FX series 'contact registration function', and, for local governments, the 'Smart Application System', 'My Number Card issuance reservation and management system', 'Application management system' and 'Emergency contact registration system' (the list of system names is a WebFetch excerpt; exact wording not verified). "This incident is unauthorised access to Arara Message, and unauthorised access to TKC's systems and data centre has not been confirmed at present." The 4th-6th notices state no count (the 6th has no body sentence containing 'records'), and the 3rd notice's "up to 2,230,812 records" is not updated (2026-11-09, https://www.tkc.jp/news/2026/20261109_1 )

rows.notes_en: Title "Apology and notice regarding unauthorised access to the Denny's app (1st notice)" (3 November 2026, PDF). Wording of the vector: "a third party created authentication information without authorisation, and the accounts of some customers were in a state where they could be accessed" (in the migration process from the old app to the new app). States that whether it was acquisition by a third party or by the person themselves has not been determined. vector was set to "unauthorised login" as account access through unauthorised creation of authentication information (vulnerability would also be possible; author's decision) (10 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked: the notice does not contain the words "unauthorised login". The wording of the vector is "It was found that, in the system processing relating to the migration from the old Denny's app to the new app, a third party created authentication information without authorisation and the accounts of some customers were in a state where they could be accessed." Classification as unauthorised login is the author's decision)

rows.notes_ja: 表題「不正アクセスによる個人情報漏えいに関するお知らせとお詫び」（2026/11/04）。経路逐語「『RESERVE GATE α』への脆弱性をついた第三者による不正アクセスにより、お客様の宿泊予約会員様の個人情報が漏えいしたことが判明いたしました。」。連鎖名：ナバック「RESERVE GATE α」（大阪コロナホテル・東京都島嶼町村一部事務組合が委託元） （2026年11月14日訂正）2026年11月9日の第二報（https://navc2.co.jp/news_detail.php?id=46 、表題「不正アクセスによる個人情報漏えいに関するお知らせとお詫び（第二報）」）。件数が初報の「最大で約35万件」から「RGα全体で、320,720件の会員情報が漏えいした可能性があります。」に改まった（内訳「・ご利用中の施設：93施設／187,687件」「・解約済みの施設：82施設／133,033件」）。状態の語は「可能性」「おそれ」。対象情報が増えた：「初報でお知らせした6項目に加え、新たに以下の情報についても漏えいしたおそれがあることが判明いたしました。」（「7.氏名カナ」「8.携帯電話番号」「9.FAX番号」「10.生年月日」「11.性別」「12.勤務先情報（会社名・部署・郵便番号・住所・電話番号・FAX番号）」）。経路は「脆弱性を突いた第三者による不正アクセスを受け」で、分類（脆弱性）は変わらない。二次被害として「漏えいした情報を悪用したとみられるフィッシングメール（偽のメール）が、会員登録後に宿泊予約をされたお客様宛てに送信されていることを確認しております。」（本文は「専用認証用アプリをダウンロード」するよう誘導）。攻撃側のAIへの言及なし。初報の「最大で約35万件」は本行の値として残す
rows.notes_en: Title "Notice and apology regarding the personal information leak due to unauthorised access" (2026/11/04). Wording of the vector: "It was found that, due to unauthorised access by a third party exploiting a vulnerability in 'RESERVE GATE α', the personal information of our customers who are accommodation booking members leaked." Chain: NAVC "RESERVE GATE α" (Osaka Corona Hotel and the Tokyo Islands Towns and Villages Partial Affairs Association are clients) (Corrected 14 November 2026) 2nd notice of 9 November 2026 (https://navc2.co.jp/news_detail.php?id=46 , title "Notice and apology regarding the personal information leak due to unauthorised access (2nd notice)"). The count was revised from the first notice's "up to approx. 350,000 records" to "Across RGα as a whole, the member information of 320,720 records may have leaked." (breakdown "- facilities in use: 93 facilities / 187,687 records" "- cancelled facilities: 82 facilities / 133,033 records"). The status words are "possibility" and "risk". The data affected increased: "In addition to the six items announced in the first notice, it was found that the following information may also have leaked." ("7. name in kana" "8. mobile phone number" "9. fax number" "10. date of birth" "11. sex" "12. employer information (company name, department, postal code, address, phone number, fax number)"). The vector is "was subjected to unauthorised access by a third party exploiting a vulnerability", and the classification (vulnerability) does not change. As secondary harm, "We have confirmed that phishing emails (fake emails) apparently misusing the leaked information are being sent to customers who made accommodation bookings after registering as members." (the text lures recipients to "download a dedicated authentication app"). No mention of AI on the attacker side. The first notice's "up to approx. 350,000 records" is kept as this row's value

rows.notes_en: Title "On the possibility of a personal information leak in the accommodation booking management system used by Tosho Kaikan" (4 November 2026 (Reiwa 8), PDF). The first notice does not contain the words "unauthorised access"; in the follow-up (https://www.tosho-kaikan.jp/1105info.pdf , "[Important] Apology and notice regarding the leak of customers' personal information", 5 November 2026 (Reiwa 8)): "We received a report from NAVC Co., Ltd. that, because [it] was subjected to unauthorised access from outside, the information of some customers who booked Tosho Kaikan leaked." Chain: NAVC "RESERVE GATE α" (10 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked: the primary-URL PDF (4 November 2026 (Reiwa 8)) contains only "(4) Count: under investigation" and "We confirmed an incident in which personal information may have leaked to the outside."; the 5 November follow-up ("3021", "to the effect that it leaked") is not there. This PDF does not contain the words "unauthorised access" either; unauthorised access from outside is stated in NAVC's own announcement (row 361). The judgement on admission criterion 3 is the author's decision)

rows.notes_ja: 表題「レッカー・ロードサービスの業務委託先への不正アクセスによる個人情報の漏えいに関するお知らせ（第一報）」（2026年11月4日）。経路逐語：委託先のシステムが「第三者による不正アクセスを受け」。290（プレステージ・インターナショナル）の連鎖。同連鎖の他の委託元：日産フィナンシャルサービス・ポルシェジャパン・はとや（11/5）、2りんかんイエローハット（11/6）、ニッポンレンタカーサービス・ソニー損保・アクサ損保・ENEOS（11/2） （2026年11月14日追記）2026年11月12日に第二報「レッカー・ロードサービスの業務委託先への不正アクセスによる個人情報の漏えいに関するお知らせ（第二報）」を公表。「漏えいした情報は、現時点で最大約285万人分と見込まれています。」「重複して計上されているケースがあるため、今後の精査により減少する見込みです。」漏えいした可能性のある項目に「口座情報（一部の利用者さま）　等」を含む（「すべての利用者さまについて、これらの情報がすべて漏えいしたものではありません。」）。第一報時点では詳細を調査中としていた。（https://www.ja-kyosai.or.jp/info/2026/20261112.html）
rows.notes_en: Title "Notice regarding the personal information leak due to unauthorised access to the contractor for towing and roadside service (1st notice)" (4 November 2026). Wording of the vector: the contractor's system "was subjected to unauthorised access by a third party". Downstream of row 290 (Prestige International). Other client organisations in the same chain: Nissan Financial Services, Porsche Japan, Hatoya (11/5), 2Rinkan Yellow Hat (11/6), Nippon Rent-A-Car Service, Sony Assurance, AXA General Insurance, ENEOS (11/2) (Added 14 November 2026) On 12 November 2026 the 2nd notice, "Notice regarding the personal information leak due to unauthorised access to the contractor for towing and roadside service (2nd notice)", was announced. "The leaked information is currently expected to cover up to approx. 2.85 million persons." "Because some cases are counted twice, the figure is expected to decrease with further examination." The items that may have leaked include "account information (some users), etc." ("Not all of this information leaked for every user."). At the time of the 1st notice the details were said to be under investigation. (https://www.ja-kyosai.or.jp/info/2026/20261112.html)

rows.notes_en: Title "An information leak has been confirmed in the email delivery service used by Kashiwazaki City". Wording of the vector: "Unauthorised access by a third party was detected" "We are confirming through the contractor." The email delivery service provider is Arara Inc. Chain: Arara (241) (Added 21 November 2026) 2nd report (press release of 17 November 2026): "Details of the information leak have been found regarding the unauthorised access to the delivery engine (Arara Inc.) of the email delivery service used by the city." Leaked information and number: "users' email addresses 4,703 records". Affected are addresses that received email from the service between 1 July and 31 October 2026 (summary). Contractor Kasix Co., Ltd.; system provider WingArc NEX Co., Ltd. (summary). (2026-11-17, https://www.city.kashiwazaki.lg.jp/soshikiichiran/sogokikakubu/genkihasshinka/1/24/2026release/202611/50750.html )

rows.notes_ja: 表題「当社Webサービスへの不正アクセスに伴う個人情報の漏えいに関するお詫びとお知らせ」（2026年11月5日）。経路逐語「第三者による不正アクセスが発生し、一部のお客さまの個人情報が漏えいしたことが判明いたしました。」。11/4のページ（https://www.e-design.net/company/information/2026/2026_11_04.html ）は「緊急システムメンテナンス」による手続き停止の告知のみで不正アクセスの記述なし（2026年11月10日、一次公表文を再取得して照合し、公表文は「不正アクセスの経路として利用されたサービス」と書くが、サービス名・委託関係は書いていない。74件は「現時点で当社が把握している個人情報が漏えいした可能性のある件数」） （2026年11月14日訂正）同一URLの公表文が「（2026年11月9日更新）」となり、見出し「2.漏えいした個人情報（2026年11月9日時点）」の件数が「71件（現時点で漏えいが確認された人数は関係者を含み93人）」に改まった。本行の「74件」（漏えいした可能性のある件数）の語はページになく、件数の近くに「可能性」の語もない（「漏えいが確認された」）。対象情報に「事故関連の情報 ： 事故日時、事故場所、事故内容、保険金支払額、事故のお相手方の氏名等」「東京海上ダイレクトアプリ情報：ご契約期間に取得された運転トリップ情報」「クレジットカード情報 ： クレジットカード会社名、クレジットカード番号の下4桁のみ、有効期限」などが並ぶ（11/5版との差分は逐語未確認）。経路は「不正アクセスの経路として利用されたサービスとの接続を停止したことに伴い、」のままで、サービス名は書いていない。攻撃側のAIへの言及なし。「74件」は本行の値として残す 既存の補足欄にある2026年11月10日の再照合（74件）と、本日取得したページ（11月9日更新・71件）の版が食い違う。取得時のキャッシュの差の可能性があり、著者の確認を要する。 一次URL：https://www.e-design.net/company/news/2026/2026_11_05.html
rows.notes_en: Title "Apology and notice regarding the personal information leak following unauthorised access to our web service" (5 November 2026). Wording of the vector: "It was found that unauthorised access by a third party occurred and that the personal information of some customers leaked." The page of 11/4 (https://www.e-design.net/company/information/2026/2026_11_04.html ) only announces the suspension of procedures due to "emergency system maintenance", with no statement of unauthorised access (10 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked: the notice says "the service used as the path of the unauthorised access", but does not give the service name or contractual relationship. The 74 records are "the number of records of personal information that may have leaked that we have grasped at present") (Corrected 14 November 2026) The notice at the same URL became "(updated 9 November 2026)", and the count under the heading "2. Personal information that leaked (as of 9 November 2026)" was revised to "71 records (the number of persons whose leak has been confirmed at present, including related persons, is 93)". This row's "74 records" (records that may have leaked) does not appear on the page, and the word "possibility" does not appear near the count ("leak has been confirmed"). The data affected lists "accident-related information: accident date and time, place, details, claim amount paid, name of the other party, etc.", "Tokio Marine Direct app information: driving trip information obtained during the contract period", "credit card information: credit card company name, last 4 digits of the credit card number only, expiry date" and others (the difference from the 11/5 version not verified verbatim). The vector remains "following the stopping of the connection with the service used as the path of the unauthorised access,", without the service name. No mention of AI on the attacker side. "74 records" is kept as this row's value. The re-check of 10 November 2026 in the existing notes (74 records) differs from the version of the page retrieved today (updated 9 November, 71 records). It may be a difference in cache at retrieval and needs the author's confirmation. Primary URL: https://www.e-design.net/company/news/2026/2026_11_05.html

rows.notes_en: Title "(updated 11/6) [Important] Apology and notice regarding the information outflow due to unauthorised access to the external email delivery service used by 'Mail Delivery Plus' and 'MakeRepeater'". Wording of the vector: "It was found that [it] was subjected to unauthorised access by a third party and that part of shops' member information entrusted for email delivery flowed out to the outside." "This matter is caused by unauthorised access to an external email delivery service," The company also has a separate case via Studio for the former GMO MakeApp (11/5, not read). Chain: Arara (241) (10 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked: in the update of 16:00 on 9 November 2026, "makeshop CRM" was added to the title and "Count: approx. 40,000 records" was added) (Added 21 November 2026) The title of the notice at the same URL became "(Updated 11/12) [Important] Apology and notice regarding information leakage due to unauthorised access to the external mail delivery service used by 'Mail Delivery Plus', 'MakeRepeater byGMO' and 'makeshop CRM byGMO'", and the update "(Updated 2026/11/12 18:00)" states "We have individually sent emails notifying the affected shops of the number of leaked records." (sent "around 16:20 on Thursday 2026/11/12"; subjects "[Important / Apology] Individual report on the leakage of email address information in MakeRepeater" and "[Important / Apology] Individual report on the leakage of email address information in Mail Delivery Plus"; response deadline "by 18:00 on Monday 2026/11/16"). This update has no count line; the counts on the page remain "Count: approx. 12.6 million records" and "Count: approx. 40,000 records" (procedural update). Parts of the text are WebFetch excerpts; the full text was not verified verbatim (2026-11-12, https://www.makeshop.co.jp/news/info/2026-11-05_2/ )

rows.dates_en: "The current investigation has found that the unauthorised access may have been carried out from around the night of 30 October 2026." "On 4 November 2026, we confirmed that the information security literacy check service operated by the association was subjected to unauthorised access by a third party."
rows.notes_ja: 表題「不正アクセスによる「情報セキュリティ理解度チェックサービス」からの利用者個人情報漏えいの恐れに関するお知らせ（第一報）」（PDF、2026年11月6日）。経路「詳細な侵入経路および影響範囲については、引き続き調査を進めております。」件数は「現在も調査を継続しており、対象件数や影響範囲については今後変動する可能性があります。」同日に個人情報保護委員会へ報告予定と記載。対象サービスは停止。
rows.notes_en: Title "Notice regarding the risk of a leak of users' personal information from the 'information security literacy check service' due to unauthorised access (1st notice)" (PDF, 6 November 2026). Vector: "We are continuing to investigate the detailed intrusion path and scope of impact." On the count: "The investigation is still continuing, and the number of records affected and the scope of impact may change." States that it plans to report to the Personal Information Protection Commission the same day. The affected service has been stopped.

[Some persons who requested materials, inquired or applied for seminars] identification number managed by us / information on companies (company name, etc.). [Employees and former employees] name, employee number, business email address, joining and leaving dates, birthday (month and day) / user names, IDs and account information for internal systems / records of business management systems

rows.dates_en: "On 27 October 2026, we confirmed that a third party logged in without authorisation to our software development server and, using authentication information stored on that server, obtained data from the cloud environment we use." (server stopped and external connections blocked the same day) "Report to the Personal Information Protection Commission (completed as of 30 October)"
rows.notes_ja: 表題「不正アクセスによる情報漏えいに関するお詫びとお知らせ」（2026年11月6日 16:00）。経路の逐語「本件は未知の脆弱性によるものではなく、当社が開発用に運用していたサーバーにおける設定と情報管理の不備が重なったことにより発生いたしました。」「不正アクセスの手法等の詳細につきましては、模倣攻撃を防止する観点から公表を差し控えさせていただきます。」vectorは不正ログイン＋設定不備のため「複合」とした。「TeamSpirit」本番環境への不正アクセスは確認されていないと記載。
rows.notes_en: Title "Apology and notice regarding the information leak due to unauthorised access" (16:00, 6 November 2026). Wording of the vector: "This matter was not caused by an unknown vulnerability but occurred because deficiencies in settings and information management on a server we operated for development combined." "We refrain from disclosing details such as the method of the unauthorised access in order to prevent copycat attacks." vector was set to "multiple vectors" because of unauthorised login plus misconfiguration. States that no unauthorised access to the "TeamSpirit" production environment has been confirmed.

rows.org_ja: ミツカン（会員向けコミュニティサイト「ミツカン 365」）
rows.org_en: Mizkan Co., Ltd. (member community site "Mizkan 365")

rows.scale_en: 487 members affected (458 tampering only; 29 leak and tampering)
rows.status_ja: 「漏えいしております」（確認）
rows.data_ja: 【漏えい・29名全員】顧客 ID および登録メールアドレス　【うち26名】本サイト内でのポイントを利用した特典交換の回数、およびキャンペーン・モニター企画への応募回数　【改ざん・487名】ニックネームが「名なしさん」に変更、ユーザーアイコンが書き換え
rows.data_en: [Leaked, all 29 persons] customer ID and registered email address. [Of whom 26 persons] number of reward exchanges using points on the site, and number of applications to campaigns and monitor programmes. [Tampered, 487 persons] nickname changed to "Nanashi-san" (anonymous), user icon rewritten
rows.dates_ja: 「10 月 30 日（金） 本サイトで第三者による不正アクセスが発生し、会員情報の改ざんと、一部の個人情報の漏えいが発生しました。」「11 月 2 日（月） 「ニックネームが勝手に変更された」との複数のお問い合わせを受けて調査を開始し、不正アクセスと個人情報の漏えいを確認しました。」「同日、本サイトを停止しました。」11月5日に個人情報保護委員会へ速報。
rows.dates_en: "Friday 30 October: unauthorised access by a third party occurred on the site, and tampering with member information and a leak of some personal information occurred." "Monday 2 November: we began investigating after receiving several inquiries that 'my nickname was changed without my permission', and confirmed the unauthorised access and the personal information leak." "The same day, we stopped the site." Preliminary report to the Personal Information Protection Commission on 5 November.
rows.notes_ja: 表題「「ミツカン 365」への不正アクセスに伴うお客様情報の改ざん・漏えいに関するお詫びとお知らせ」（PDF、2026年11月6日）。経路の逐語「原因は、本サイトの会員情報を変更する機能や、画面に情報を表示する仕組みに不備があったことです。」「第三者がこの不備を悪用して他のお客様のニックネームやアイコンの登録情報を勝手に書き換え、そこに仕込んだ不正なプログラムが、お客様が本サイトを開いた際に作動したことで、一部の個人情報が取得されました。」公表文は「脆弱性」の語を使わず「不備」と表現（vectorは内容から脆弱性に分類）。「漏えいした情報にログイン用パスワード、氏名、住所、電話番号、クレジットカード情報が含まれていた事実は確認されておりません。」「ミツカン公式通販」「Fibee 腸内会」は11月4日から一時停止。（2026年11月10日、一次公表文を再取得して照合し、公表文は「脆弱性」ではなく「本サイトの会員情報を変更する機能や、画面に情報を表示する仕組みに不備があった」「悪用されたプログラムの不備」と書く）
rows.notes_en: Title "Apology and notice regarding the tampering and leak of customer information following unauthorised access to 'Mizkan 365'" (PDF, 6 November 2026). Wording of the vector: "The cause was deficiencies in the function for changing member information on the site and in the mechanism for displaying information on screen." "A third party exploited these deficiencies to rewrite other customers' nickname and icon registration information without permission, and a malicious program planted there ran when customers opened the site, through which some personal information was obtained." The notice does not use the word "vulnerability" but "deficiency" (vector is classified as vulnerability from the content). "It has not been confirmed that the leaked information included login passwords, names, addresses, phone numbers or credit card information." "Mizkan official online shop" and "Fibee Chonaikai" temporarily stopped from 4 November. (10 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked: the notice does not say "vulnerability" but "there were deficiencies in the function for changing member information on the site and in the mechanism for displaying information on screen" and "the program deficiencies that were exploited")

rows.notes_en: Title "Apology and notice regarding the possibility of a personal information leak on our official online shop" (2026.11.06). The vector is only "unauthorised access to the administration screen", with no statement of the intrusion method. States that login passwords and credit card information are not among the data leaked (not confirmed: from a secondary source; the relevant sentence in the notice not retrieved). A separate case from existing row 142 "Doutor Coffee (internal system, employee information)". The contractor's name is not disclosed. A dedicated phone line opened on 11 November.

rows.org_ja: 滋賀大学（安否確認システム「ANPIC」・運用会社アバンセシステム／メール配信「アララ メッセージ」）

rows.scale_ja: 記載なし（本学分。ANPIC全体は「ANPICからのメール送信に使用されたメールアドレス約100万件の漏えいが確認されたとのことです。」）
rows.scale_en: Not stated for the university (about 1,000,000 email addresses for ANPIC overall, per the operator)
rows.status_ja: 「漏えいが判明」（運用会社報告）／本学分は「確認でき次第お知らせします」
rows.status_en: Leak reported by operator; university's share under confirmation
rows.data_ja: ANPICに登録されているメールアドレス
rows.data_en: Email addresses registered in ANPIC
rows.dates_ja: 「本学では、10月30日、運用会社から、情報漏えいは発生しておらず安全性が確認された旨の報告がありました。」「しかし、11月3日、運用会社から、その後の調査結果の訂正によりメールアドレスの漏えいが判明したとの連絡がありました。」
rows.dates_en: "On 30 October, the university received a report from the operating company that no information leak had occurred and safety had been confirmed." "However, on 3 November, the operating company notified us that, owing to a correction of subsequent investigation results, a leak of email addresses had been found."
rows.notes_ja: 表題「安否確認システム（ANPIC）に関連するメールアドレスの漏えいについて」（2026/11/6）。経路の逐語「ANPICがメール配信に利用する「アララ メッセージ」（アララ株式会社）が第三者による不正アクセスを受け、ANPICからのメール送信に使用されたメールアドレス約100万件の漏えいが確認されたとのことです。」「この件数は本学のみの件数や利用者の実人数を示すものではなく、漏えいしたメールアドレスの対象範囲や重複等については、現在、運用会社等が調査を進めています。」連鎖名：アララ（ANPIC経由）。ANPICのメール送信機能は停止中・再開未定。（2026年11月21日追記）第2報（表題「安否確認システム（ANPIC）に関連するメールアドレスの漏えいについて（第2報）」、2026/11/19）。「漏えいした情報は、2026年7月1日から10月31日までの間にANPICから送信されたメールの宛先メールアドレス27件です。」「なお、氏名、所属、パスワード等の漏えいは確認されていません。」（2026-11-19、https://www.shiga-u.ac.jp/48624/ ）
rows.notes_en: Title "On the leak of email addresses relating to the safety confirmation system (ANPIC)" (2026/11/6). Wording of the vector: "'Arara Message' (Arara Inc.), which ANPIC uses for email delivery, was subjected to unauthorised access by a third party, and a leak of approx. 1 million email addresses used for sending emails from ANPIC was reportedly confirmed." "This figure does not indicate the number for the university alone or the actual number of users, and the operating company etc. are currently investigating the scope of the leaked email addresses and duplicates." Chain: Arara (via ANPIC). ANPIC's email sending function is stopped; resumption undecided. (Added 21 November 2026) 2nd report (title "On the leak of email addresses relating to the safety confirmation system (ANPIC) (2nd report)", 19 Nov 2026). "The leaked information is 27 recipient email addresses of emails sent from ANPIC between 1 July and 31 October 2026." "No leak of names, affiliations, passwords, etc. has been confirmed." (2026-11-19, https://www.shiga-u.ac.jp/48624/ )

rows.dates_en: "On Tuesday 3 November 2026, we were notified by Fujitsu Limited that unauthorised access by a third party had been carried out against Arara Inc.'s email delivery service used by Fujitsu." "As a result of subsequent investigation, on Wednesday 4 November it was found that our customers' information may have flowed out."

Wording of the vector: "unauthorised access by a third party occurred in the email delivery service of Arara Inc., Fujitsu Limited's subcontractor". "There is no impact on the ordering system of our net supermarket itself." Chain: Arara (via Fujitsu). A separate case from existing row 293 "Life Corporation (Life official app)".

"On 4 November 2026, we received notice that personal information we handle had leaked." "From 28 October 2026 to 30 October 2026, it has been confirmed that the leaked email addresses were misused and suspicious emails were sent."

rows.notes_en: Title "Apology and notice regarding the leak of IR newsletter registration information due to unauthorised access to an external cloud service" (6 November 2026). Wording of the vector: "in Tribeck Inc.'s external cloud service, which we use to deliver our IR newsletter, the server of Arara Inc., which provides the email delivery function, was subjected to unauthorised access by a third party" "Arara Inc.'s investigation reports a vulnerability in the company's web server and problems in the system environment as the cause of this matter." "Initially, Tribeck Inc. reported to us to the effect that 'the environment we used is not affected by the leak', but". Chain: Arara (via Tribeck).

rows.dates_ja: ①10月28日(水) アララ社より不正アクセス発生の一報、11月2日(月) パ・リーグ球団のお客様メールアドレス流出の報告、11月5日(木) 13,711件流出の報告受領　②11月4日(水)「千葉ロッテマリーンズにて、球団公式サイトの管理システム内に身に覚えのないページが作成されていることを確認。」「PLMによる調査の結果、10月30日(金)に第三者による不正アクセスがあり、メールアドレスとご登録のニックネームを含むファイルがダウンロードされていたことを確認。」11月6日(金) 件数判明
rows.dates_en: (1) Wednesday 28 October first report from Arara of unauthorised access occurring; Monday 2 November report of outflow of Pacific League clubs' customers' email addresses; Thursday 5 November report received of 13,711 records flowing out. (2) Wednesday 4 November "At the Chiba Lotte Marines, it was confirmed that pages we did not recognise had been created in the club's official site management system." "As a result of PLM's investigation, it was confirmed that there was unauthorised access by a third party on Friday 30 October and that a file containing email addresses and registered nicknames had been downloaded." Friday 6 November count found
rows.notes_ja: 表題「不正アクセスによるお客様メールアドレス等流出のお詫びとお知らせ」（2026年11月6日 16時00分）。取得上の注意：当事者（パシフィックリーグマーケティング）名義のPR TIMES配信文を読んだ。自社ドメイン上の同文は未確認。2事案を1公表文で報告：①委託先アララ経由（連鎖名：アララ）、②球団公式サイトの管理システムへの直接の不正アクセス（経路の具体は非公表）。vectorは委託先＋直接侵入のため「複合」。①の対象は「2026年7月1日(水)以降に対象サービスよりメールを配信したアドレス」。
rows.notes_en: Title "Apology and notice regarding the outflow of customers' email addresses, etc. due to unauthorised access" (16:00, 6 November 2026). Retrieval note: the PR TIMES distribution in the name of the party concerned (Pacific League Marketing) was read. The same text on its own domain not confirmed. Two cases reported in one notice: (1) via the contractor Arara (Chain: Arara), (2) direct unauthorised access to the club's official site management system (path details not disclosed). vector is "multiple vectors" because of contractor plus direct intrusion. Those affected in (1) are "addresses to which emails were delivered from the affected services from Wednesday 1 July 2026".

Wording of the vector: "investigation found that there was unauthorised access misusing a function of our management system" "The intrusion path has been identified, and countermeasures have been implemented for the part misused this time" (path details not disclosed). 3,000 points granted per person as an apology. (10 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked: the vector is described as "unauthorised access misusing a function of the management system" and "the intrusion path has been identified", without the word vulnerability. (10 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked: the count and the 2nd notice's status word are from the 2nd notice https://www.kinkos.co.jp/corporate/archives/news/20261109/ (2026.11.09), not the first-notice page. "The Smart Membership member email addresses confirmed to have flowed out this time number 266,395.")

rows.dates_en: "At about 10:20 a.m. on Monday 2 November, the system of Prestige Core Solution Co., Ltd. (hereinafter Prestige Core Solution), to which ENEOS Corporation (hereinafter the company) outsources part of the administration work relating to 'ENEOS Car Lease', which it provides, was subjected to [unauthorised access] by a third party" (not verified verbatim: it continues "was subjected to unauthorised access, and it was found that customers' personal information relating to the work outsourced by the company leaked to the outside.") / table "Period of unauthorised access" "29 October to 30 October 2026"
rows.notes_ja: 表題：「カーリースの管理業務委託先システムへの不正アクセスによる個人情報漏洩について」（2026年11月2日、ENEOS株式会社）。経路の逐語：「第三者による不正アクセスを受け」「なお、本件は当社のシステムが不正アクセスを受けたものではありません。」。連鎖名：プレステージ・インターナショナル（290）。読めたENEOSの公表文は11月2日付で、ページに11月9日の更新・追記はなく、Charge Plus への言及もない。11/9付とされる「Charge Plus」法人会員への波及の公表文には到達できず（照合待ちに別記）。既存行201（ENEOS Power「ENEOSでんき」）とは別事案。日付欄 の文の後半は2回の取得の結合で、1文としての逐語は未確認。
rows.notes_en: Title: "On the personal information leak due to unauthorised access to the system of the contractor for car lease administration" (2 November 2026, ENEOS Corporation). Wording of the vector: "was subjected to unauthorised access by a third party" "This matter is not one in which the company's system was subjected to unauthorised access." Chain: Prestige International (290). The ENEOS notice that could be read is dated 2 November; the page has no update or addition of 9 November and no mention of Charge Plus. The notice said to be dated 11/9 about the spread to "Charge Plus" corporate members could not be reached (recorded separately as pending). A separate case from existing row 201 (ENEOS Power, "ENEOS Denki"). The latter half of the sentence in the dates field is a combination of two retrievals, and its wording as a single sentence is not verified verbatim.

rows.notes_en: Title (3rd notice "[Important] On the information leak due to unauthorised access to the email delivery contractor (3rd notice)", 9 November 2026 (Reiwa 8). 1st notice "[Important] Apology and notice regarding the possibility of an information leak (1st notice)", 2 November 2026 (Reiwa 8), https://www.fesc.or.jp/cms/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/%E3%81%8A%E8%A9%AB%E3%81%B3%E3%83%A1%E3%83%BC%E3%83%AB.pdf ; 2nd notice, 4 November 2026 (Reiwa 8), https://www.fesc.or.jp/cms/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/%E3%81%8A%E8%A9%AB%E3%81%B3_%E2%91%A1.pdf ). Vector: "Unauthorised access occurred to the server of Arara Inc., which provides the email delivery service, and a leak of approx. 77 million email addresses from the system managed by the company was found." Chain: Arara (241). Discovered through the announcement of the 3rd notice (11/9). Whether the 1st notice's "today, 2 November" is the intrusion date or the discovery date not verified verbatim from the wording. The primary URL is written in Japanese (the encoded version could not be retrieved because of WebFetch's URL length limit). (10 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked: the primary-URL PDF is the 3rd notice (9 November 2026 (Reiwa 8)), and the announcement date of 2 November is the date of the 1st notice given in the text)

rows.notes_ja: 表題（「宝くじ公式サイトおよび公式アプリの一時停止について」、2026年11月6日）。名義は「全国都道府県及び全指定都市」、問い合わせ先は宝くじコールセンター。状態の逐語：「調査の結果、宝くじ公式サイトにおいて、一部のお客さまについて第三者による不正ログインがあり、お客さまのパスワードが意図せず変更される事象に加え、当該第三者により会員情報が閲覧された可能性があることを確認いたしました。」「なお、現時点で、宝くじ公式サイトのサーバーやデータベースへの侵入の形跡はなく、また会員データの流出も確認されておりません。」経路の逐語：「外部で入手されたメールアドレスとパスワードの一覧を用いた不正ログインの可能性がある」。PDFは https://sorry.takarakuji-official.jp/Sorry-PlannedMaintenance.html（www.takarakuji-official.jp から302転送されるお知らせページ）からリンクされた takarakuji-preliminary.jp 上のもの。パーセントエンコードしたURLはWebFetchプロキシが長さで拒否したため、日本語のままのURLで取得。11月9日付「宝くじ公式サイト以外での宝くじ購入手段について」PDFに不正ログイン・件数の新しい記述はなし。（2026年11月10日、一次公表文を再取得して照合し、公表文は「当該第三者により会員情報が閲覧された可能性があることを確認いたしました。」「会員データの流出も確認されておりません。」と書く。収載基準2の境界） （2026年11月14日追記）2026年11月11日の更新で、閲覧された可能性がある会員情報の項目を公表した。「氏名、生年月日、性別、住所、電話番号、メールアドレス、当せん金受取口座情報（金融機関名、口座番号の上４桁、口座名義）、クレジットカード情報（クレジットカード番号の下４桁）、購入履歴（くじ種類、金額、当落情報）、プロフィール画像（登録者のみ）」。「現時点で、宝くじ公式サイトのサーバーやデータベースへの侵入の形跡はなく、また会員データの流出も確認されておりません。」「本事案は外部で入手されたメールアドレスとパスワードを用いた不正ログイン（いわゆる「リスト型攻撃」）の可能性があるため」。件数の記載なし。表題「宝くじ公式サイトおよび公式アプリの一時停止について」（2026 年 11 月 11日（更新））。 一次URL：https://www.takarakuji-preliminary.jp/newsrelease_20261111.pdf
rows.notes_en: Title ("On the temporary suspension of the Takarakuji official website and official app", 6 November 2026). Issued in the name of "all prefectures and all designated cities"; the contact is the Takarakuji call centre. Wording of the status: "As a result of the investigation, we confirmed that on the Takarakuji official website there were unauthorised logins by a third party for some customers, and that, in addition to customers' passwords being changed unintentionally, member information may have been viewed by that third party." "At present, there are no traces of intrusion into the servers or databases of the Takarakuji official website, and no outflow of member data has been confirmed." Wording of the vector: "there may have been unauthorised logins using a list of email addresses and passwords obtained elsewhere". The PDF is on takarakuji-preliminary.jp, linked from https://sorry.takarakuji-official.jp/Sorry-PlannedMaintenance.html (a notice page to which www.takarakuji-official.jp redirects with 302). The percent-encoded URL was rejected by the WebFetch proxy because of its length, so it was retrieved with the URL in Japanese. The 9 November PDF "On ways to buy Takarakuji other than the official website" has no new statement on unauthorised logins or counts. (10 November 2026, primary notice re-retrieved and checked: the notice says "we confirmed that member information may have been viewed by that third party." "No outflow of member data has been confirmed either." On the boundary of admission criterion 2) (Added 14 November 2026) In the update of 11 November 2026, it announced the items of member information that may have been viewed: "name, date of birth, sex, address, phone number, email address, prize-receiving account information (financial institution name, first 4 digits of the account number, account holder), credit card information (last 4 digits of the credit card number), purchase history (lottery type, amount, win/loss information), profile image (registrants only)". "At present, there are no traces of intrusion into the servers or databases of the Takarakuji official website, and no outflow of member data has been confirmed." "Because this matter may be unauthorised logins using email addresses and passwords obtained elsewhere (a so-called 'list-based attack')". No count stated. Title "On the temporary suspension of the Takarakuji official website and official app" (11 November 2026 (updated)). Primary URL: https://www.takarakuji-preliminary.jp/newsrelease_20261111.pdf
